notes:
Top-line: large enterprise search vendor evaluating Redwood for massive-scale embedding + rerank stack. Primary ask: support 100M-1B vector index with predictable cost-per-query and sub-200ms p95 end-to-end rerank latency for 3-stage pipeline.

Key stakeholders: CTO (Evelyn Zhang), Head of Search (Diego Morales), SRE (Priya Rao). AE: Jordan Kim. SE: Lina Patel. CSM placeholder: Marco Ruiz.

POC/bench highlights:
- Indexing: tested 120M dense vectors (768-d) via current pipeline (Pinecone for ANN + in-house cross-encoder). Baseline costs: ~$0.0012/avg query (includes ANN + cross-encoder compute).
- Latency: baseline p95 ~420ms (ANN call 120ms + network + cross-encoder 300ms). Goal: p95 <= 200ms for end-to-end rerank.
- Throughput: target steady-state 220 qps with 95th percentile spikes to 450 qps during peak search events.
- Cost target: <$0.0006 per query at 100M vectors; need clear unit-econ analysis for 1B vector projection.
- Accuracy: evaluating reranker improvement on MRR; required +6-8% delta vs current cross-encoder baseline to justify migration.

Technical requirements discussed on calls:
- Co-located reranker (GPU) adjacent to ANN store to avoid network hops for candidate fetch + cross-encoder.
- Support for large batch scoring, dynamic batching size controls and latency SLO overrides.
- Prefix/KV caching for hot queries and session affinity (support conversational RAG).
- Quantized model recommendations (4-bit/8-bit) with Redwood Optimize suggestions to hit cost targets without >2% quality loss.
- Deterministic fallback policy: model variant downgrade + region fallback during capacity events.

Security/compliance notes:
- Must support SSO/SAML and audit logs for all inference calls.
- KMS integration for customer key management; proof of SOC2 + pen test results requested.
- Data residency: EU tenant data must remain in EU region (legal review open).

Customer quotes (paraphrased):
- "If we can't get p95 under 200ms at scale, we keep the hybrid approach." — Head of Search
- "Unit cost at 1B vectors is the gating item for procurement." — CTO

Existing integration proof artifacts:
- Drive: auric-poc-indexing results (see drive link).
- Fireflies: full transcript for 2026-03-05 benchmark run.

Commercial/ops:
- Procurement wants a blended price for Dedicated + Optimize tools; looking at 12–24 month committed capacity.
- Legal loop: information security questionnaire submitted 2026-02-25; redlines expected by 2026-03-22.

Sales notes / shorthand:
- POC = positive performance trends, still 2x latency gap to target. Need infra placement + GPU selection discussion w/ infra team.
- Next on-site benchmark week (data + cluster) to run 500M vector job and full rerank pipeline (provisioning checklist in drive).

Quick items to action:
- SE to propose Dedicated GPU SKU options + expected p95 numbers by 2026-03-18.
- Send quantization plan + expected MRR delta from Redwood Optimize.
- Procurement: draft SOW + pricing by 2026-03-20.
